fdroid:com.agepony.app.name: AgePony: Encrypt & Sign
fdroid:com.agepony.app.summary: Post-quantum file & message encryption with age. On-device, private, no ads.
fdroid:com.agepony.app.description:
AgePony is a fast, private encryption app for your phone, built on the modern age encryption format. Lock your files and messages so only the right person can open them, sign them so recipients know the file really came from you, and keep your keys and data on your device. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics.
POST-QUANTUM ENCRYPTION
Protect your data against "harvest now, decrypt later" attacks. AgePony generates quantum-safe hybrid keys (ML-KEM-768 combined with X25519) that stay secure even against a future quantum computer, while staying fully interoperable with the age command-line tool. Anything encrypted to a quantum-safe recipient is clearly badged, so you always know the protection you are using.
Also included:
- Encrypt and sign in a single step, so recipients can both open your file and confirm it is really from you.
- A built-in migration tool to upgrade older files to quantum-safe encryption. Batch re-encrypt your existing files to a new quantum-safe key, with your originals kept until the new copy is verified.
WHY AGEPONY
- Standard age encryption. AgePony reads and writes the same format as the age CLI, so your files work with other age tools on desktop and server.
- Public key or passphrase. Encrypt to someone's public key, or lock a file with a passphrase you share separately.
- SSH signing, done properly. Sign and verify files from the Files tab using SSH Ed25519 or RSA keys, a hardware key, or a security key over NFC, and keep a list of trusted signers. Signatures use the SSHSIG standard, so ssh-keygen verifies them.
- On device by default. Encryption, decryption, signing, and key generation all happen locally on your phone, and your private keys never leave your device.
- One optional online step. When you import a recipient from GitHub, AgePony fetches that person's public SSH keys from github.com. That is the only network request the app makes, it happens only when you tap Fetch, and nothing about you is sent.
- No tracking, no ads, no account required. AgePony does not collect analytics or personal data.
- Open source. The full source is available for review.
FEATURES
- Generate and store age key pairs in an app vault, unlocked with your device biometrics.
- Quantum-safe hybrid keys (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) alongside classic X25519 keys.
- Encrypt and decrypt files and text messages.
- Passphrase encryption for quick, key-free sharing.
- Sign and verify files (SSHSIG) with SSH Ed25519 or RSA keys, hardware keys, or a security key over NFC, with a trusted-signers list.
- Unlock with your biometric, a password, or a PIN, so the app works even with no screen lock set up.
- Optional duress password that wipes the vault when entered.
- Scan recipient keys with your camera by QR code.
- Import a recipient from a GitHub username, fetching their public SSH keys from github.com.
- Batch migrate existing files to quantum-safe encryption.
Whether you are a journalist, an activist, a developer, or simply someone who wants real control over their private files, AgePony gives you strong, standard encryption without the complexity.
AgePony is an independent app built on the open age encryption format and is not affiliated with the age project.

fdroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.name: Let Me Downgrade
fdroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.summary: Add support for downgrading apps on Android 12 through 17.
fdroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.description:
Android's app installation system does not allow users to downgrade to an older version of an app when they already have a newer version installed. Let Me Downgrade is an Xposed module for Android 12 through 17 that enables users to bypass this restriction. The app provides a Status screen with a switch to allow or block downgrades at any time. You can also add an optional App Downgrades Quick Settings tile that mirrors the same on/off state for quicker access.
 ⚠️ WARNING: Let Me Downgrade is intended for rooted devices running Android 12 through 17 and requires Xposed. The required Xposed variant to use is LSPosed. Other Xposed variants will not work. Additionally, this module cannot be guaranteed to work on all devices. In the worst case, it can cause a bootloop. Use at your own risk.
To use Let Me Downgrade:
1. Install an LSPosed build with API 101 support. This requires your device to be rooted with Magisk or KernelSU.
2. Install Let Me Downgrade.
3. Activate the Let Me Downgrade module in the LSposed user interface.
4. Reboot your device and sign in.
5. Open Let Me Downgrade from your launcher. When the module is active in LSPosed, the Status card shows whether app downgrades are allowed or blocked; use the switch to turn the hook on or off.
6. Optionally, add the App Downgrades Quick Settings tile from the tile editor. The tile mirrors the in-app switch.

fdroid:com.dtgibson.snowraven.name: SnowRaven
fdroid:com.dtgibson.snowraven.summary: Birding tools and data explorer for your eBird and Macaulay Library exports
fdroid:com.dtgibson.snowraven.description:
SnowRaven reads your eBird and Macaulay Library exports and gives you weather and tides for your checklists, your history with every species, life-list statistics, and an interactive map, on your own phone or tablet. It is free and open source, built by one birder for their own data, and it works alongside eBird and the Macaulay Library.
Weather
Paste a checklist ID and get a weather and tide summary ready to drop into the checklist comment, or look up the forecast for any place and time ahead. The Weather/tide Planner lays out the coming sunrises and sunsets, each with its tide and forecast weather.
Statistics
A dashboard built from your eBird backup: life-list totals and growth, milestones, and when and where you bird. A weather section reads back the weather blocks SnowRaven and RainCrow write into checklist comments: the conditions on the outings you wrote a block for.
Map Explorer
Your sightings on an interactive map, with nearby eBird hotspots and where species new to you were reported recently. Counties shade by your counts or by how complete your county list is, with a California Breeding Bird Atlas overlay.
Species Detail
Your whole history with one bird: sightings, field notes, breeding codes, a map of every observation, and any splits or lumps along the way. A weather card shows the skies and temperatures you found it in, from SnowRaven and RainCrow weather blocks.
Calendar
A year of your birding as twelve month grids, each day shaded by how many species you saw. Fold the years together, or narrow it to a single species.
Targets
A county's targets over your own record: the lifers there, the birds you have yet to photograph, record, or film, and the ones you have never given a breeding code. Rank them by eBird's frequencies or by what has been reported lately.
Multimedia
Your life list as a media checklist: which species you have photographed, recorded, and filmed, and which you still need. Narrow it by sex and age.
Breeding Codes
Every species you have recorded breeding evidence for, as a matrix against eBird's breeding codes, colored by evidence tier.
Checklists
Your checklists as whole outings: search every comment you have written, and filter by what an outing has.
List Comparer
Two life lists side by side, or any two public checklists: what they share and what only one has.
Named Birds
Tag an individual bird by name in a species comment and SnowRaven gathers everything you have on it: sightings, places, a timeline, its own media. With several named birds, one strip puts them all on a shared time axis.
Privacy
Private by default, and in your control: no account, no analytics, no telemetry, no server we run. Your eBird backup, Macaulay Library export, and API keys stay on your device, and in your phone's own backup if you use one. The Android app has no Google services, no Firebase, and no crash reporter. SnowRaven's own code makes no request to Google. Its screens are drawn by your phone's Android System WebView, a system component that may contact Google on its own; SnowRaven turns off the WebView's Safe Browsing and usage statistics, and has no setting for the rest. Privacy policy: https://snowraven.dtgibson.com/privacy.html
What you'll need
A free eBird API key and a free OpenWeather API key subscribed to its One Call by Call plan (activating it needs a payment card on file; set a usage cap to avoid charges), entered once in Settings. Most tabs also read your eBird backup and, for the media features, an optional Macaulay Library export.
Network services
SnowRaven relies on network services that are not free software: eBird for checklist details, hotspots, and recent sightings, and OpenWeather for weather, each used with your own API key, plus Esri's World Imagery for the optional Satellite map. Maps come from OpenFreeMap, with optional USGS topographic and Waymarked Trails layers, place search uses OpenStreetMap's Nominatim, and tides come from NOAA.

 Features

 A Forgejo server where Renovate opens pull requests. Mergejo recognises them by their renovate/ branch names.
 A Forgejo personal access token with the read:user, write:repository and write:issue scopes. Mergejo talks only to the server you enter.

VaultPony creates and opens encrypted containers on Android. A vault is a single

The containers are compatible with VeraCrypt, so you can open the same vaults on

There is no account, no cloud, and no network access. Your vaults are just files,
kept wherever you choose.
Features:
* Create and open VeraCrypt-compatible containers, with a choice of cipher, hash
 (including Argon2id), and filesystem (FAT or exFAT).
* Hidden volumes: conceal a second vault inside the first. Two passwords, and the
 outer one gives no sign the hidden one exists. The outer volume can be
 write-protected so normal use will not overwrite the hidden data.
* Header backup and recovery, in-place password change, and keyfiles.
* Biometric unlock, auto-lock when the app leaves the foreground, a hidden-screen
 mode that blocks screenshots, and a no-trace mode that remembers nothing.
* Localized in English, German, Spanish, French, Russian, and Brazilian
 Portuguese, with live in-app switching.
VaultPony is free and open source, built on a shared Rust core you can inspect.
It is not affiliated with or endorsed by IDRIX; VeraCrypt is a registered
trademark of IDRIX.

fdroid:eu.woshicado.circletoshare.name: Circle to Share
fdroid:eu.woshicado.circletoshare.summary: Crop and share a screenshot from anywhere; nothing is saved unless you ask.
fdroid:eu.woshicado.circletoshare.description:
Circle to Share captures the screen from anywhere, lets you crop it, and shares, copies or saves the result — nothing is kept on your device unless you ask.
Trigger it, the screen freezes, and you can circle what you want.
Then tap Share, Copy or Save.
A shared or copied crop lives in the app's private cache only and never lands in your gallery;
Save puts it into your Screenshots folder.
How to open it (use any of them):
* Power button (assistant-powered): press and hold.
* Corner swipe (assistant-powered): swipe up from a bottom corner.
* Quick Settings tile: tap it and the shade closes before the capture.
* Floating bubble: an optional, always-on-screen button you can tap from any app and drag out of the way.
Highlights:
* No permissions: no internet, storage, camera, microphone, or location.
* Nothing is saved to your device (unless you tap Save).
* QR codes in the capture are highlighted, and can be opened, copied, or shared.
* Optional snapping: crop edges align with the buttons, cards and images that were on screen.
* Scrollshots (experimental): "More above"/"More below" in the crop tool to scroll the app underneath.
Accessibility service: the Quick Settings tile, the floating bubble, snapping, scrollshots, and a capture fallback for devices that don't hand screenshots to third-party assistants use Android's AccessibilityService API. It is optional and off until you agree to the in-app disclosure and switch it on. It captures the screen and reads element positions at the moment you trigger a capture, and scrolls the app underneath only when you tap "More above" or "More below". The list of your apps on the scrollshot settings page is read on your device when you open it and is not stored.
Note: screens that block screenshots (banking apps, DRM video) cannot be captured.

 Same rules as Normal mode
 Deterministic disc generation for puzzle-solving

 Beautiful UI: Modern Material 3 design with gradient backgrounds
 Animations: Smooth disc drops and break effects

1. Tap a column to drop the current disc
2. Match numbers: A disc breaks when contiguous discs in its row OR column equal its number
3. Chain reactions: Breaking discs can trigger more breaks for bonus points
4. Solid discs: Appear solid gray, crack once after first adjacent break, reveal a number after second adjacent break
5. Survive: Avoid filling the past the top row

apple-macos:6759498010.description:
Reqeast is a native API client for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Built with SwiftUI and Rust. Test HTTP, call gRPC, open TCP/TLS, send UDP, connect WebSocket, and subscribe to SSE. Six protocols in one app.
No Electron. No cloud accounts. No sign-up. Launches instantly. Your data stays on your devices. Synced through iCloud. Nothing else.
HTTP
Request builder with GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and OPTIONS. Headers, query params, and body as JSON, form data, URL encoded, text, or binary. Eight auth types: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, API Key, JWT Bearer, Hawk, AWS Signature V4, Akamai EdgeGrid, and more coming. Responses with syntax highlighting, JSON tree, images, and hex. Cookies built in. HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2.
gRPC
Unary and streaming RPCs. Server reflection, local proto library with multi-file bundles, hex message mode. Proto bundles sync over iCloud.
WebSocket
Persistent bidirectional real-time connections. Custom headers, subprotocol, auto-ping, and TLS with insecure mode for development.
Server-Sent Events
Subscribe to SSE endpoints and watch event streams in real time. Event type and ID with full conversation history.
TCP and TLS
Raw TCP connections or TLS sessions. Persistent and one-shot modes. UTF-8, hex, base64, configurable line endings. Message history per session.
UDP
Send and receive datagrams with bind port and timeout. Same encoding options as TCP.
Environments
Variables per project with {{variable}} syntax. URLs, headers, body, auth. Secrets in Keychain. Switch instantly.
Code Snippets
Request code in 10 languages: cURL, HTTP raw, Python, Node.js, JavaScript Fetch, Java, Go, C#, Swift, and Rust.
Import
Paste cURL, HTTPie, or wget into requests. Import API specs: OpenAPI, Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, HAR, AsyncAPI, and GraphQL SDL from paste, file, URL, multi-file bundle, or Git. Link a project to a remote spec, review changes, and apply updates without losing local edits. On-device Apple Intelligence fallback for unrecognized formats.
Project Organization
Group requests into projects with icons and colors. Project and request folders. History with full snapshot restore.
iCloud Sync
Projects, requests, and environments sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac through iCloud. Credentials through Keychain.
Apple Shortcuts
Six actions for HTTP, gRPC, TCP, UDP, WebSocket, and SSE. Automate from Shortcuts, Siri, or other tools. Variables and parameters at runtime.
jq Filter
Filter and transform JSON with jq in the response view. Optional unquote for string results.
Export
Export all projects as one file. Share or back up locally. Export a project as OpenAPI 3.1 or Postman Collection v2.1.
Syntax Highlighted Editor
CodeEdit editor with tree-sitter, line numbers, and code folding for JSON, XML, HTML, JavaScript, and SQL.
Event Log
Diagnostic log filtered by protocol and severity. Up to 1,000 entries for connection and traffic debugging.
Rust networking core for heavy IO. Native SwiftUI interface with Liquid Glass.
Every feature is free. No limits. No paywalls. No feature gating.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6809646301.description:
SyncFit reads the Apple Health data you choose and delivers it where you want it: iCloud Drive, Google Drive, any Files folder, your own REST API, a PostgreSQL or SQL Server database, email, or your Calendar. There is no SyncFit server in between. Every export runs on your iPhone and goes straight from your phone to the destination you picked.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPORT
Over 190 Apple Health types: heart rate, HRV, resting heart rate, oxygen saturation, steps, distance, active and basal energy, exercise and stand time, sleep stages, body measurements, workouts with routes and heart rate data, ECG, audiograms, state of mind, nutrition and more. Pick the metrics, the date range and the units.
FORMATS
CSV with one row per sample, ready for Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets. JSON in a documented schema with stable sample identifiers. A JSON layout compatible with Health Auto Export importers. GPX for workout routes. Raw samples or hourly, daily, weekly and monthly aggregates.
DESTINATIONS
• iCloud Drive and Files: CSV export is included free.
• Google Drive
• REST API: POST or PUT the file to your endpoint with a bearer token and custom headers. Retries with backoff on transient failures.
• PostgreSQL and SQL Server: structured rows, tables created for you, upserts by sample id so re-running never duplicates.
• Email: send the file as an attachment through your own SMTP account.
• Calendar: put workouts and sleep sessions on a calendar you choose.
AUTOMATIONS
Run exports on a schedule, when new data arrives, or when a workout ends. Incremental jobs remember where they left off and only send new samples. History shows every run with its status. Reminders and completion alerts keep you informed. Shortcuts and Siri can trigger jobs and read your latest readings.
TODAY DASHBOARD
See your key metrics at a glance and customise which ones appear. Open any metric for historical charts.
SYNCFIT FOR MAC
The same purchase includes the Mac app. Send a dataset through your own iCloud and explore it with dashboards, period comparisons, notes and tags, and PDF and HTML reports. Read directly from iCloud, Google Drive or your PostgreSQL or SQL Server database.
PRIVACY
Your health data stays on your devices and goes only to destinations you configure. SyncFit has no cloud, no analytics on your health data, and no account requirement. Credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain. Sign in with Apple is optional and used only to share your purchase between devices.
PRICING
The Today dashboard, saved manual jobs and CSV export to iCloud Drive or Files are free. Every Pro feature is available for a 3-day trial. Pro is a single one-time purchase that unlocks iPhone and Mac. No subscription.
Documentation, the JSON schema, CSV columns and a reference receiver are at syncfithealth.app.

The Blue Guides Hungarian Food App provides a dictionary and miscellany of all the Hungarian food and drink words you are likely to find on a menu or in a market. Suitable for browsing or on-site use, it is a self-contained app which once downloaded does not need Internet access and thus incurs no expensive roaming charges or download delays. With full searchability and indexing you can find what you want instantly. An audio guide for each entry gives immediate pronunciation guidance.
The app is based on the content of the Blue Guide Hungary Food Companion, which, as well as the useful dictionary function, gives background, facts and guidance, for example on such things as the seasonality of particular foods, historical origins, classical references or regional specialities. All this content is available in the app. The book is available at good bookshops for £9.95 / $12.99. 
Now in a LITE (limited to only around 500 words) and a PRO (nearly 2,000 words) version, you can try the functionality and ease-of-use of the free app then, if you choose, upgrade to the full version with a simple in-app purchase.

flathub:com.gooseberrydevelopment.pinepo.summary: A complete, self-hosted podcast management system
flathub:com.gooseberrydevelopment.pinepo.description:
PinePods is a Rust based podcast management system that manages podcasts with multi-user support and relies on a central database with clients to connect to it. It's browser based and your podcasts and settings follow you from device to device due to everything being stored on the server. You can subscribe to podcasts and even hosts for podcasts with the help of the PodPeopleDB. It works on mobile devices and can also sync with a Nextcloud server or gpodder compatible sync server so you can use external apps like Antennapod as well! NOTE: This is the client edition of Pinepods. You must have a server to connect to in order to use this app.
 Instructions for setting up your own self-hosted server can be found on the main repo

flathub:com.ktechpit.red.name: Red
flathub:com.ktechpit.red.summary: YouTube client with TV mode, no ads
flathub:com.ktechpit.red.description:
Red is a YouTube client for the Linux desktop: a native app to watch YouTube without ads, with
 a smart TV mode, a YouTube Music mode, SponsorBlock, media keys, a mini player and a built-in YouTube
 downloader. Sign in with your Google account and your subscriptions, history and recommendations
 work as on the website, in a lightweight window instead of a browser tab.
 Three ways to watch, one window:
 Desktop mode: the full YouTube website, signed in, in light, dark or system theme, with picture-in-picture
 style mini player
 TV mode: the YouTube Leanback interface from smart TVs and consoles, full screen, driven
 by keyboard, mouse or gamepad controller, ideal for a media center, living room PC or handheld
 Music mode: YouTube Music in the same window, a music player with media keys, tray and MPRIS
 controls, background play, and audio downloads one click away
 Watch without interruptions:
 Ad blocker built in: video ads, banners and sponsored feed items are removed before the page
 renders, and playback is never touched
 Tracker blocking, SponsorBlock to skip sponsor segments, intros and reminders, Return YouTube
 Dislike counts, and a switch to hide Shorts
 Download what you watch:
 YouTube video downloader for any video, playlist or channel, as MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K
 YouTube to MP3: save audio only as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV for music
 Subtitles, thumbnail, metadata and chapters embedded; sponsor segments cut out on request
 Playlists detected from any link, entries picked one by one, a queue with pause, resume and
 retry
 Your YouTube sign-in is reused, so age-restricted videos and anything your account can watch
 download too
 Made for the desktop:
 Media keys and MPRIS media controls, a tray icon with play, pause and skip, the screen kept
 awake while a video plays
 Hardware video decoding, native Wayland and X11, notifications when a download finishes,
 single instance that opens YouTube links from the command line
 Red is a lightweight alternative to the browser tab, to Electron YouTube apps and to a separate
 downloader. Everything works on any Linux distribution.

flathub:eu.fortysixandtwo.chessclock.name: Chess Clock
flathub:eu.fortysixandtwo.chessclock.description:
Chess Clock is a simple application to provide time control for over-the-board
 chess games. Intended for mobile use, players select the time control settings
 desired for their game, then the black player taps their clock to start white's
 timer. After each player's turn, they tap the clock to start their opponent's,

flathub:eu.stethewwolf.gresistor.name: gResistor
flathub:eu.stethewwolf.gresistor.description:
To allow for identification, resistors are usually marked
 with colored bands. Often refered to as color codes, these
 markings are indicative of their resistance, tolerance and
 temperature coefficient. gResistor helps you translate
 resistor color codes into a readable value. All you have to
 do is watch the colors on the resistor and then enter them
 in the program. As you enter colours you'll see that the
 resistor value is changing accordingly.

flathub:xyz.splashmapper.Splash.name: Splash
flathub:xyz.splashmapper.Splash.description:
Splash is a video mapping software, dedicated to deploying immersive spaces. Splash takes care
 of semi-automatically calibrating the videoprojectors (field of view, optical shift, projection
 blending and color), and feeding them with the input video sources. Calibration relies on a 3D
 model of the projection surfaces, which allows for matching the real and virtual spaces. Ultimately
 this can lead for instance to projecting onto mobile objects, or hiding the physical space when
 used with head tracking.
 Splash is very flexible, but its user interface is organized around one main goal: mapping immersive
 spaces and allow for creators to bring content to the physical world using any tool they know and
 master. As such the main features of Splash are:
 Unlimited outputs, including physical (graphics card) and network outputs (NDI)
 Semi-automatic projectors calibration, based on a 3D model of the physical space
 Automatic blending computation of any number of projectors, whatever the overlapping between
 them
 Real-time blending computation, allowing for blending moving tracked objects
 Unlimited number of video inputs, live and pre-rendered
 Entirely controlable through OSC
 Scriptable through Python
 Runs on single board computers as well as media servers
 Does one thing, as best as possible

firefox-addons:2639165.name: RegretsReporter
firefox-addons:2639165.summary: The RegretsReporter browser extension, built by the nonprofit Mozilla, helps you take control of your YouTube recommendations.
firefox-addons:2639165.description: What does it do? The RegretsReporter extension gives you more control over your YouTube experience. RegretsReporter brings YouTube’s algorithmic controls to the forefront of your feed, giving you a simple way to tell YouTube’s algorithm to stop recommending certain videos, and also to report the recommendations that you regret. RegretsReporter is only for people who are 18 or older. This extension is part of a crowdsourced investigation into YouTube’s algorithm to learn more about what people regret being recommended and how the algorithm responds to user feedback. You can choose to opt-in to donating your data to support our research upon installing the extension. By contributing your data to our research you can help us improve one of the most powerful recommendation engines on the planet. How does it work? RegretsReporter overlays a “stop recommending” button onto the thumbnail of each video that appears in your YouTube recommendations. Pressing this button will send feedback directly to YouTube, telling them that you don’t want to be recommended that type of video in the future. After sending this feedback, you can provide an optional comment to help us learn more about why that recommendation was unwanted. If you choose to opt-in to Mozilla’s crowdsourced research project upon installing the extension, Mozilla will monitor your recommendations to see whether YouTube is really listening to the feedback that you send. This contributes to our advocacy work to put people in control of their experiences with online algorithms. What kind of data am I donating when I use RegretsReporter? If you choose to opt-in to Mozilla’s crowdsourced research project, the extension will send Mozilla information about the number of videos you view, your use of features to control your recommendations, and what kinds of videos you are recommended. If you choose to opt-out, Mozilla will not receive any data about your YouTube usage as part of our investigation into YouTube’s algorithm. We encourage users to read our Privacy Notice for more detailed information about data collected through RegretsReporter. Is my privacy protected? Throughout this process, your privacy is paramount. If you opt-in to our research project, the data Mozilla collects is linked to a randomly-generated user ID, not your YouTube account. Your data may be used in Mozilla Foundation's advocacy and campaigning work. It may be shared with organizations working to investigate recommender systems and technologists working to build more trustworthy AI. When we disclose information, we disclose it in a way that minimizes the risk of you being re-identified. The extension gathers no data when you browse in a private browsing window. For more detailed information about your privacy please read the RegretsReporter Privacy Notice. What will you do with the information from RegretsReporter? We will use information from the RegretsReporter extension to power our advocacy and campaigning work. Specifically, to hold YouTube and other companies accountable for the AI developed to power their recommendation systems. And, to put people in control of their experiences with online algorithms. In July 2021 Mozilla used RegretsReporter data contributed by 37,380 people to power the largest-ever crowdsourced investigation into harmful recommendations on YouTube. The investigation was covered by more than 170 news outlets across 30 countries and resulted in YouTube making changes to its algorithm and releasing more information to the public about how it works. Does this work on mobile? No. Currently this extension is compatible with Firefox and Chrome on desktop only. Is RegretsReporter available in multiple languages? RegretsReporter will function no matter what language your YouTube account is set to, and our analysis will include videos in languages other than English. However, the extension interface is only available in English for now.

apple-macos:1518005460.name: Rechnungsverwalter Cloud
apple-macos:1518005460.description:
Rechnungsverwalter Cloud brings your shared invoicing database to iPhone and iPad. The app works directly on the same cloud database as the “Rechnungsverwalter Cloud” programme for Windows and macOS: whatever you enter on the go, your colleagues at the desk see straight away – and vice versa.
IMPORTANT: REQUIRES AN EXISTING CLOUD ACCESS
The app is a pure cloud client. You need the hosting key of your Rechnungsverwalter Cloud and your user – or you create a new account in the app. No hosting account yet? Create one right in the app – it sets up the new cloud database just like the desktop programme. Your data lives in the cloud, so an internet connection is required.
Prefer to work offline on the device only? Use the app “Rechnungsverwalter” (Invoice Manager) instead – it keeps everything locally on your iPhone or iPad.
SEVERAL USERS, ONE DATABASE
• Sign in with your desktop user and password, optionally with Face ID
• A document being edited is locked for others – no change gets lost
• History: who changed which invoice, document or customer, and when
• Users and locks at a glance, change your own password
INVOICES
• Items from the catalogue, text lines and discounts
• Status open, paid, overdue, cancelled and exchange, with “paid on”
• Print view as PDF with logo, footer and bank details
• Send by e-mail, export as XRechnung
DOCUMENTS
• Quotes, order confirmations, delivery notes, purchase orders and letters with the types and templates from your database
• Turn a document into an invoice with a few taps
CUSTOMERS AND EXPENSES
• Customers with address, contact and all their documents
• Expenses with account, input tax and a receipt photo from the camera
REPORTS
• Income, expenses and open items by month and by customer
• CSV and PDF export of the lists
ON THE DEVICE
As on the desktop, logo, print settings, mail account, time tracking and receipt photos stay on the individual device.
All settings such as sender address, bank details, footers, tax rates, units and text templates come from the shared database – set up once on the desktop, available on iPhone and iPad straight away.
Six languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian.

apple-macos:6827333418.name: Stoop FM: Music Radio
apple-macos:6827333418.description:
Your music app holds everything you already love. Stoop FM is for everything you haven't found yet.
Hundreds of radio stations, each a scene, a sound or an era, play all day through Apple Music: Ghanaian highlife, Detroit techno, Bay Area hyphy, Laurel Canyon, baroque mornings and a lot more. Tune in and you land mid-song, like radio. Not feeling it? Swipe to the next station, or roll the dice for a random one.
TRY A SOUND BEFORE IT'S YOURS
Hear an hour of a scene before deciding it belongs in your library. No albums to pick, no playlists to build.
DON'T THINK, JUST LISTEN
Nothing to choose, nothing to queue. Put a station on and let it play.
A PARTY ANYONE CAN STEER
Pass the phone. Anyone can change the mood in one tap.
KEEP WHAT STICKS
Bookmark a station, heart a song, add what grabs you to your Apple Music library.
START FROM WHAT YOU KNOW
For You lines up stations around artists already in your library, matched on your device.
SEND A STATION TO A FRIEND
Share a link to any station, or the song playing on it. Friends can hear previews in a browser or tune in from the app. Share the stations you make, too, and put your favorites on a page of your own at stoop.fm.
GO DEEPER WHEN YOU WANT
A map of every station by the artists they share, journeys that drift from station to station on their own, and each station's page with what's on now and what's next.
YOUR PLAYLISTS, AS STATIONS
Turn any of your Apple Music playlists into a station of your own, with its own cover, playing on the clock like the rest. Your first one is free; Your Stations unlocks as many as you like, with one purchase.
Every station's cover is drawn from its sound, not an artist's face, so you pick on a hunch.
On iPhone, iPad and Mac, with CarPlay, Apple Watch and Home Screen widgets. New songs arrive every week.
Full songs play through your Apple Music subscription. Without one, you can browse every station and hear 30-second previews. Listening is free, with no ads and no subscription.
